details.label: Discussion
details.text: A persistent storm cluster is moving south-southeastward across central IL late this evening. While this cluster has struggled to maintain severe intensity, MLCAPE of near/above 2000 J/kg and relatively enlarged low-level hodographs (with effective SRH of 150-200 m2/s2) may continue to support modest storm organization and transient rotation into the early overnight hours. This could support potential for localized wind damage for as long as this cluster remains vigorous, though a gradual weakening trend is eventually expected with time

mesoscaleDiscussions.summary: An isolated severe threat will continue with an ongoing supercell. Trends are being monitored for any storm clustering with time

details.label: Summary
details.text: An isolated severe threat will continue with an ongoing supercell. Trends are being monitored for any storm clustering with time

details.label: Discussion
details.text: An ongoing supercell across northeast CO will continue to pose a short-term threat for localized hail and severe gusts as it moves south-southeastward. Recent objective mesoanalyses depict an 850-mb moisture axis extending southeast from ongoing convection into northwest KS, and recent VWPs from KGLD indicate a strengthening nocturnal low-level jet. These factors may allow for some increase in storm coverage and clustering (as depicted by some recent HRRR/RRFS runs), within a favorably unstable (MUCAPE of 2000-3000 J/kg) and sufficiently sheared environment. However, the current isolated nature of the ongoing threat and increasing MLCINH with time result in uncertainty regarding overnight severe potential downstream. Some increase in elevated storm coverage has recently been noted over far southwest NE, and if convection can continue to increase in coverage later tonight, then steep lapse rates above the surface and relatively large DCAPE could support modest cold pool generation and an increasing severe-wind threat, despite increasing near-surface stability. Local watch expansion and/or new watch issuance will be possible if trends support an increasing downstream severe threat overnight
